definitions.label: 模拟延期成本
definitions.description: Σ late_cost × tardiness; unfinished orders count as finishing at horizon+1

methods.missing: MISSING/ERROR excluded and counted; NOT_APPLICABLE excluded, not counted as missing
methods.intervals: RATE: Wilson score; MEAN: percentile bootstrap (n≥3); others: none
methods.pairing: pairs share scenario, seed and budget; incomplete pairs are counted as unpaired
methods.significance: exact Wilcoxon signed-rank, reported only with ≥6 non-zero paired differences

setup.note: same simulator, budget and scoring functions for every strategy; LLM_STUB results are a deterministic stand-in, not a real model
